chunks.arabic_text: الكَافِي: عِدَّةٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَىٰ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ أَبَانَ قَالَ

translations.en: Al-Kafi: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban who said:

chunks.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي الْأَحْوَلُ أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ بَعَثَ إِلَيْهِ وَهُوَ مُسْتَخْفٍ، قَالَ: فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقَالَ لِي: يَا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ مَا تَقُولُ إِنْ طَرَقَكَ طَارِقٌ مِنَّا أَتَخْرُجُ مَعَهُ. قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: إِنْ كَانَ أَبُوكَ أَوْ أَخُوكَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَهُ. قَالَ: فَقَالَ لِي: فَأَنَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَخْرُجَ أُجَاهِدَ هَٰؤُلَاءِ الْقَوْمَ فَاخْرُجْ مَعِي. قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَا مَا أَفْعَلُ جَعَلْتُ فَدَاكَ. قَالَ: فَقَالَ لِي: أَتَرْغَبُ بِنَفْسِكَ عَنِّي؟ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ: إِنَّمَا هِيَ نَفْسٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِنْ كَانَ لِلَّهِ فِي الْأَرْضِ حُجَّةٌ فَالْمُتَخَلِّفُ عَنْكَ نَاجٍ وَالْخَارِجُ مَعَكَ هَالِكٌ وَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ لِلَّهِ حُجَّةٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَالْمُتَخَلِّفُ عَنْكَ وَالْخَارِجُ مَعَكَ سَوَاءٌ. قَالَ: فَقَالَ لِي: يَا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ كُنْتُ أَجْلِسُ مَعَ أَبِي عَلَى الْخَوَانِ فَيُلْقِمُنِي الْبَضْعَةَ السَّمِينَةَ وَيُبَرِّدُ لِي اللَّقْمَةَ الْحَارَّةَ حَتَّىٰ تَبْرُدَ شَفَقَةً عَلَيَّ وَلَمْ يَشْفَقْ عَلَيَّ مِنْ حَرِّ النَّارِ. إِذًا أَخْبَرَكَ بِالْدِينِ وَلَمْ يُخْبِرْنِي بِهِ؟ قُلْتُ لَهُ: جَعَلْتُ فَدَاكَ مَنْ شَفَقَتِهِ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حَرِّ النَّارِ لَمْ يُخْبِرْكَ، خَافَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ لَا تَقْبَلَهُ فَتَدْخُلَ النَّارَ. وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَا فَإِنْ قَبِلْتُ نَجَوْتُ وَإِنْ لَمْ يُبَالِ أَنْ أَدْخُلَ النَّارَ. ثُمَّ قُلْتُ لَهُ: جَعَلْتُ فَدَاكَ أَنْتُمْ أَفْضَلُ أَمْ الْأَنْبِيَاءُ؟ قَالَ: بَلِ الْأَنْبِيَاءُ. قُلْتُ: يَقُولُ يَعْقُوبُ لِيُوسُفَ: ﴿يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُؤْيَاكَ عَلَىٰ إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا لَكَ كَيْدًا﴾ لِمَ لَمْ يُخْبِرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ لَا يَكِيدُوهُ وَلَكِنْ كَتَمَهُمْ ذَلِكَ، فَكَذَلِكَ أَبُوكَ كَتَمَكَ لِأَنَّهُ خَافَ عَلَيْكَ. قَالَ: فَقَالَ: أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ قُلْتَ ذَلِكَ لَقَدْ حَدَّثَنِي صَاحِبُكَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ أَنِّي أُقْتَلُ وَأُصْلَبُ بِالْكُنَاسَةِ وَأَنَّ عِنْدَهُ لِصَحِيفَةٍ فِيهَا قَتْلِي وَصَلَابِي. فَحَجَجْتُ فَحَدَّثْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ بِمَقَالَةِ زَيْدٍ وَمَا قُلْتُ لَهُ، فَقَالَ لِي: أَخَذْتَهُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَعَنْ شِمَالِهِ وَمِنْ فَوْقِ رَأْسِهِ وَمِنْ تَحْتَ قَدَمَيْهِ وَلَمْ تَتْرُكْ لَهُ مَسْلَكًا يَسْلُكُهُ

translations.en: Al-Ahwal reported to me saying: Zayd ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them) sent for me while he was in hiding, so I went to see him. He said to me: O Aba Ja'far, what will you say if a caller from among us knocks on your door, would you come out with him? I said to him: If it were your father or your brother, I would go out with him. He said to me: I wish to go out and fight these people, so come out with me. I said: No, I will not do so, may I be your ransom. He said to me: Do you prefer your life over mine? I said to him: It is only one soul. If Allah has a proof (Hujjah) on the earth, then the one who stays back from you is saved and the one who goes out with you is destroyed. And if Allah does not have a proof on the earth, then the one who stays back and the one who goes out with you are the same. He said to me: O Aba Ja'far, I used to sit with my father on the dining mat, and he would feed me the fattest piece of meat and cool the hot morsel for me until it cooled, out of concern for me. But he did not show concern for me enough to save me from the fire of Hell. So why did he inform you about the religion and not inform me? I said to him: May I be your ransom, it is because of his concern for you from the fire of Hell that he did not inform you; he feared that you would reject it and enter the Fire. But he informed me; if I accept I am saved, and if he does not care if I enter the Fire. Then I said to him: May I be your ransom, are you better or the prophets? He said: The prophets. I said: Ya'qub said to Yusuf: 'O my son, do not relate your dream to your brothers lest they devise a plot against you.' Why did he not inform them so they would not plot against him, but rather he kept it secret from them? In the same way, your father kept it secret from you because he feared for you. He said: By Allah, if you say that, your companion in Medina has told me that I will be killed and crucified in al-Kunasa, and that he has a scroll in which my killing and crucifixion are written. So I performed Hajj and informed Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about Zayd's statement and what I said to him. He said to me: You took him from all sides, front and back, right and left, above his head and below his feet, and did not leave him any way out.

en.summary: This hadith captures the intellectual debate between Zayd ibn Ali and the scholar al-Ahwal regarding the theological implications of his uprising against the Umayyads. Al-Ahwal argues that if Zayd is the divinely appointed Imam (Hujjah), remaining in hiding ensures salvation, whereas joining the battle risks martyrdom without guaranteeing success; if he is not the Imam, the outcome is equal for both. Imam al-Sadiq validates this reasoning by noting that al-Ahwal’s argument was so comprehensive that it left Zayd with no logical escape, highlighting the Shia scholarly emphasis on the distinction between the Imam's infallible authority and the political risks of rebellion.
en.seo_question: What was the theological argument used to explain why Imam Ali did not inform Zayd ibn Ali about the Imamate?

key_terms.حُجَّةٌ: Proof (of God on earth, referring to the Imam)
key_terms.الْمُتَخَلِّفُ: The one who stays behind (from the uprising)
key_terms.الْخَارِجُ: The one who goes out (to fight)
key_terms.الْكُنَاسَة: Al-Kunasa, a place in Medina where Zayd was crucified
key_terms.صَاحِبُكَ: Your companion (referring to the Imam, specifically Ja'far al-Sadiq)
key_terms.مَسْلَكًا: A way out or escape route (for the argument)

تَقْبَلَهُ فَتَدْخُلَ النَّارَ. وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَا فَإِنْ قَبِلْتُ نَجَوْتُ وَإِنْ لَمْ يُبَالِ أَنْ أَدْخُلَ النَّارَ. ثُمَّ قُلْتُ لَهُ: جَعَلْتُ فَدَاكَ أَنْتُمْ أَفْضَلُ أَمْ الْأَنْبِيَاءُ؟ قَالَ: بَلِ الْأَنْبِيَاءُ. قُلْتُ: يَقُولُ يَعْقُوبُ لِيُوسُفَ: ﴿يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُؤْيَاكَ عَلَىٰ إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا لَكَ كَيْدًا﴾ لِمَ لَمْ يُخْبِرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ لَا يَكِيدُوهُ وَلَكِنْ كَتَمَهُمْ ذَلِكَ، فَكَذَلِكَ أَبُوكَ كَتَمَكَ لِأَنَّهُ خَافَ عَلَيْكَ. قَالَ: فَقَالَ: أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ قُلْتَ ذَلِكَ لَقَدْ حَدَّثَنِي صَاحِبُكَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ أَنِّي أُقْتَلُ وَأُصْلَبُ بِالْكُنَاسَةِ وَأَنَّ عِنْدَهُ لِصَحِيفَةٍ فِيهَا قَتْلِي وَصَلَابِي. فَحَجَجْتُ فَحَدَّثْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ بِمَقَالَةِ زَيْدٍ وَمَا قُلْتُ لَهُ، فَقَالَ لِي: أَخَذْتَهُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَعَنْ شِمَالِهِ وَمِنْ فَوْقِ رَأْسِهِ وَمِنْ تَحْتَ قَدَمَيْهِ وَلَمْ تَتْرُكْ لَهُ مَسْلَكًا يَسْلُكُهُ
